rows.note: Use this specifically for a tortoiseshell-patterned domestic cat rather than the material or the turtle.

example.english: My tortoiseshell cat is always hiding under the sofa.
example.traditional: 我隻玳瑁貓成日匿喺梳化底。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 doi6 mou6 maau1 seng4 jat6 nik1 hai2 so1 faa3 dai2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for tortoiseshell material and for the hawksbill turtle, with context distinguishing the two.

example.english: This tortoiseshell hairpin was left to me by my grandmother.
example.traditional: 呢支玳瑁髮簪係我阿嫲留畀我嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 doi6 mui6 faat3 zaam1 hai6 ngo5 aa3 maa4 lau4 bei2 ngo5 ge3
